purpose: Reusable pattern for deploying a private backend with GitHub, Render, and protected external API credentials.
principles: Never commit secrets to source control.
Store runtime credentials only in the hosting provider's secret environment variables.
Verify health, authentication, and external API access separately.
Stop before credential entry when user-controlled secrets are required.

stages.name: Repository setup
actions: Create or identify a private GitHub repository.
Initialize application structure.
Add .gitignore and .env.example.
Do not place real credentials in files.
stages.checkpoint: Repository exists and contains no secrets.

stages.name: Secure backend
actions: Implement health endpoint.
Implement authentication middleware.
Implement external API adapter.
Restrict adapter to required permissions.
Add automated tests.
stages.checkpoint: Tests pass and protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests.

stages.name: Hosting deployment
actions: Connect private GitHub repository to Render.
Set the correct runtime.
Use npm ci for Node dependency installation.
Use npm start for application startup.
Configure health check.
Keep secrets as Render environment variables.

stages.name: Credential injection
actions: Create only the required environment-variable names.
User enters secret values directly into Render.
Never paste or print secrets in chat, logs, commits, screenshots, or documentation.
stages.checkpoint: Required secrets exist in the hosting environment.

stages.name: Post-deployment verification
actions: Test /health.
Test authentication with an invalid token.
Test authentication with the valid token.
Test external API authentication.
Verify expected read-only behavior.
Verify prohibited capabilities remain unavailable.

stages.name: Reusable workflow handoff
actions: Record repository, runtime, build command, start command, environment-variable names, endpoints, tests, and deployment status.
Convert the workflow into a template for the next automation.
stages.checkpoint: Runbook is stored with the project.
